question: Who among the following won the ‘EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2019’ award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw**__.

__
 
• **Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw won the ‘EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2019’ award.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw:**

 
 
• She is the founder of **Biocon Limited and Biocon Biologics Limited.**
 
• Dr Kiran Mazumdar Shaw was honoured with the** EY Entrepreneur Of The Year Award 2019** and she also represented India at the **World EOY Award.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/351c694ec509ccc016d841f5c8670708ad63f2fff7c0fdc8e3a70e665fc549bb.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adi Godrej** was honoured with the **Lifetime Achievement Award.**

 
 
• He is the** Chairman of the Godrej Group**.
 
 
 
• **Tuhin Parikh** won the** Transformational Impact Person of the Year**.
 
 
• He is the **Senior Managing Director-Real estate, Blackstone India.**
 
 
 
• **Uday Suresh Kotak** is the executive vice-chairman and managing director of **Kotak Mahindra Bank.**
